meta.name: mem-setup
meta.description: This skill should be used when the user asks to "set up claude-mem", "pair claude-mem", "connect cmem", "add my cmem key", "set up cloud sync in Cowork", or provides cmem.ai Connect values (sync token, user id, SyncHub URL) for this plugin. Configures the claude-mem-cowork plugin credentials.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 输入 cmem 连接信息,完成 claude-mem 凭证配置
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你需要为 claude-mem 插件配置连接凭证
copy.tagline_en: Enter cmem connection details and complete the claude-mem credential setup.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to configure claude-mem plugin credentials.

howto.what: 安装后，当你提出配对请求并给出 cmem.ai 的连接信息（如同步令牌），Claude 会把它们写入插件配置，也可写入本地 claude-mem 设置，再运行状态检查并给出掩码结果。它不会把令牌打印出来；若要长期生效，会提示打包插件重装。
howto.when: 当你说“set up claude-mem”“pair claude-mem”“connect cmem”等配对/连接请求，或直接提供 cmem.ai Connect 的连接信息时触发。

say.note: 按步骤写入 config.json 并验证状态

say.text: 连接 cmem，我的 sync token 是 cm_xxx
say.note: 只通过文件写入，不暴露令牌

say.text: 把这段 cmem.ai Connect 信息配到插件里
say.note: 自动提取同步令牌、用户 ID 和 SyncHub URL

howto.what_en: Given cmem.ai credentials during pairing, Claude writes them into plugin config (optionally local claude-mem settings), runs status check, shows masked output, does not echo token, and suggests repackaging for persistence.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user says “set up claude-mem”, “pair claude-mem”, “connect cmem” or similar pairing/connection requests, or when they directly provide cmem.ai Connect credentials.

say_en.text: Connect cmem, my sync token is cm_xxx
say_en.note: Writes via files only; never echoes the token

say_en.text: Add this cmem.ai Connect info to the plugin
say_en.note: Extracts sync token, user ID and SyncHub URL
